title: Scorpion landing page events
description: Two schemas in one file. The root (#/$defs/event) is one event file, events/<id>.yaml. #/$defs/feed is events.json, the asset of the rolling `events` release that scripts/build-events.mjs writes and the host fetches (docs/plan.md §4). Rules a schema can't express are checked by scripts/build-events.mjs and src/lib/events.ts: `start` and `end` are real calendar dates of the same kind, `end` is not before `start`, the id equals the file name and is unique, every URL parses as an https: URL without user name or password, and keywords are unique ignoring case. Compatibility (docs/plan.md §4): clients reject entries with unknown fields, so within schemaVersion 1 a field is only ever added as optional, and no event file uses it before the page that knows it is deployed; any other change bumps schemaVersion.

when.description: A date `YYYY-MM-DD` (all-day, a day in Europe/Berlin) or a date-time with seconds optional and an offset, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS](Z|+HH:MM|-HH:MM)`.

id.description: Equals the file name without .yaml, for example `denbi-plenary-2027`.

type.description: What kind of event it is. Decides the Bioschemas markup in events.jsonld (docs/plan.md §4): `training` is a Course with a CourseInstance; the others are an Event, `workshop` and `hackathon` with the eventType "workshops and courses" (a hackathon also gets the keyword `hackathon`), `meeting` and `conference` with "meetings and conferences".

start.description: First day, or the start time.

end.description: Last day (inclusive), or the end time. Same kind as `start` and not before it. The event is past after the end of this day in Europe/Berlin, or after this instant.

location.description: Where the event takes place as shown on the page, the same in both languages, for example `Göttingen` or `Online`.

url.description: The event's own page, https: only. Optional: without it, the event's URL is https://scorpion.bi.denbi.de/#event-<id>, its card on the landing page.

registration.description: Where to register, https: only. Shown as a "Register" link.

host.description: The organisation that hosts the event (Bioschemas hostInstitution; the provider of a training).

ror.description: ROR id as a URL, for example https://ror.org/01vmpm840.

contact.description: Whom to ask about the event, shown on the page. Preferably an office or function rather than a person. At least one of `email` and `url`.

email.description: Shown as a mailto: link. No ? # & % or / characters.

address.description: The venue's postal address, for the structured data (Place with PostalAddress). The page shows `location`.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example DE.

mode.description: How a training is delivered (Bioschemas courseMode). Required for `training`, not allowed for other types.

keywords.description: Keywords in English, without commas. Required for `training`.

language.description: The language the event is held in, an ISO 639-1 code. Default `en`.

tess.description: false leaves the event out of events.jsonld, which ELIXIR TeSS harvests, for example when TeSS already lists it from another source. It is still shown on the page. Default true.

feed.description: events.json: the upcoming events at the time it was built, sorted by start and then id. Clients still drop events whose end has passed since.
